authorization.bounded_by: HANDOFF-2026-10-04.md. No GPU spend without a separate explicit approval (option D). No AAII SOTA claim.

target_index.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
target_index.quote: Status: Included in Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 at 15% weighting.
target_index.spec_status_meaning: Method, prompts, and scoring rules are pinned. NO dataset and NO executable harness are present in the attached documents. Every dataset and harness is referenced by URL only.
target_index.anti_laundering: While spec_status != IMPLEMENTED, final_verdict() MUST return NOT_A_BENCHMARK_RESULT. An AAII number cannot be produced from this harness in its current state.

claims_under_test: C1: The harness separates a known-good solver from a chance-level agent on a task family with known ground truth.
C2: The harness refuses to emit a benchmark result for any adapter whose dataset is not pinned by sha256.
C3: The harness fails closed on a non-finite metric rather than comparing it (D51).
C4: A gate with an empty fail_if is rejected at construction (D40/D47 class).

gates.statement: The instrument separates a perfect solver from a chance agent.
gates.fail_if: solver_minus_chance < 0.30, i.e. the harness cannot distinguish skill from guessing and has no instrument power.
gates.note: D46 ceiling-effect guard: if both agents score 1.0, the instrument has no headroom and the result is void.

gates.statement: The chance agent sits near its analytic chance rate.
gates.fail_if: chance_abs_error > 0.12, i.e. the scoring path leaks the answer and the negative control is broken.

gates.statement: Determinism: the same seed yields the same score across two processes.
gates.fail_if: determinism_max_delta > 0.0, i.e. the run is not reproducible and no receipt can be trusted.

gates.statement: An unpinned AAII adapter yields no score.
gates.fail_if: unpinned_adapters_scored != 0, i.e. a fabricated benchmark number can be produced. This is the gravest failure mode.

falsifiers: A gate with empty fail_if that still returns a verdict -> G-TOOL-4 fails.
A non-finite metric that is compared instead of refused -> G-TOOL-5 fails.
Two identical seeds producing different scores -> G-TOOL-3 fails.
Any AAII adapter returning a numeric score while spec_status is METHODOLOGY_ONLY -> G-SPEC-1 fails.
not_claimed: No AAII v4.3.2 score of any kind.
No SOTA claim on any track.
No GPU run; no store write.
No claim that the real AAII harness (Stirrup, E2B, mini-swe-agent) has been reproduced. Those are external and are referenced, not reimplemented.

environment_pinned.note: CPU only. torch has no CUDA. Any GPU run requires the Vast path and explicit approval.
